analysis.title: Equity Index Vol Update 13Nov26
key_insights: The 13 Nov session was choppy with low realized vol at the index level. SPX closed 7,561.67 (-0.40%), NDX 27,943.74 (-1.22%), RUT 2,790.54 (-0.31%), VIX 19.30 (+0.60pts).

Futures rallied pre-market on an in-line PPI print, which brought relief after Tuesday's hot CPI report and the repricing of rate hike odds. The rally faded and fixed strike vols went bid after the open, especially in short-dated expiries, as the market sold off about 120 SPX handles.
Spot recovered and vols failed to hold their bid, drifting lower into the close. Vol of vol caught an aggressive bid on several sizable buyers of VIX December calls.
After the close, a Reuters report that all airports were ground stopped by order of the FAA Command Center sent ES futures down 60bps. They retraced part of the move before the weekend close.

Flows tilted strongly toward hedging. Several buyers took VIX December calls (Dec 25, 26 and 29 strikes). A very large seller sold the VIX Nov 34 calls, 130k at 0.12, collecting $1.56mm in premium if the November VIX future settles below 34 on Wednesday morning.
NVDA earnings on Tuesday after the close are the main event next week, following an extremely volatile week for the company and the announcement of a new interim CEO (NYT).
The macro calendar is quieter next week, headlined by FOMC meeting minutes on Wednesday and UMich inflation expectations on Friday.
The daily straddle was not realized on 13 Nov. Monday's straddle is priced at 78bps and next Friday's straddle at 1.65%.
earnings_insights: NVDA reports Tuesday 17 Nov after the close. The desk calls it the focus of next week after an extremely volatile week for the stock and the announcement of a new interim CEO (NYT). No EPS or revenue estimates are given.

vol_and_positioning: VIX closed at 19.30, up 0.60pts, on a day SPX fell 40bps. Realized vol at the index level stayed low.
Fixed strike vols went bid after the open, especially in short-dated expiries, as SPX sold off about 120 handles. They failed to hold the bid and drifted lower into the close.
Vol of vol caught an aggressive bid on several sizable buyers of VIX December expiry calls.

Flows tilted strongly toward hedging. Notable trades: VIX Dec 29 calls bought 43,864 at 0.9993 live, VIX Dec 25 calls bought 36k at 1.31 vs 19.9 on a 33-day basis, VIX Dec 26 calls bought 56,677 at 1.127 live.
A very large seller sold VIX Nov 34 calls, 130k at 0.12 live, collecting $1.56mm in premium if the November VIX future (UX1) settles below 34 on Wednesday morning.
Monday's straddle went out at 78bps and next Friday's straddle at 1.65%, after the daily straddle failed to realize on 13 Nov.
Post-close, the FAA ground stop headline sent ES futures down 60bps before a partial retrace.
